interface.title: Spectral Panel Picker
interface.field: Flow cytometry / spectral cytometry (immunology panel design)
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment planning: choosing fluorochromes for an antibody panel before staining and acquisition
interface.what_it_is_for: Choosing one fluorescent dye per marker so the dye signatures in a spectral flow panel stay as distinct as possible, with extra protection for key markers, and checking an existing panel for dye pairs that will be hard to unmix.

data.note: Everything ran on the built-in signatures simulated from FPbase spectra for BD FACSDiscover S8 lasers (the sidebar says 'Good for ranking, the exact numbers will differ from the instrument'). The Pick tab opens with 6 markers already filled in (CD4, CD8, CD25, FOXP3, Helios, Live/Dead). The Check tab opens with DAPI, GFP (EGFP), PE and APC. The optional CSV upload in the sidebar was not tried because no test files were provided.

Tick 'key' on the markers that matter most
Press Find panels (warns if a row is empty)
